pp_overview: I thought I did, until I realized it was costing me time. I wanted to use the crosswalks every time they were available, but I soon learned that in some cases it was better to just beeline it to the top. Then I would see the red cars and panic and try to find a crosswalk and wind up getting hit. Sometimes it seemed like there were way more cars than normal and that would panic me too. I would try to hit the other arrows, but I wasn't fast enough. I know it sounds like a copout but  my keys would stick sometimes. I'm 53 and my reflexes are not like they used to be and that was an issue as well.
pp_bonus_score: At first I didn't even pay attention to the bonus scores because I was just so focused on trying to get to the top before I died or ran out time. But eventually I felt like I was getting the hang of the game and I actually started paying attention. But I was more so paying attention to how many seconds I had left in the game, than the bonus points. So seeing how quickly I could get to the top was more of a motivation than the bonus points.
